payload.core_mechanism_summary: Topological sort to order chapters, then DP to compute max read-throughs. dist[i] = max(1, max_{j in prereqs} dist[j] + (i < j))
payload.rationale: Uses DFS for topological sort and cycle detection, then processes DAG in reverse order with a 1D DP array where state represents number of reads to reach each chapter, leveraging prerequisite order.
